positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: what did the CTO commit to in adopting Zypherion for the analytics pipeline?
positions.why: These three expressions from Quinton Fairweather cohere as a single decision package: the declarative adoption of Zypherion (src-1), the performance justification of 15x faster columnar queries (src-2), and the commissive migration timeline of next quarter (src-3). Read together they answer what the CTO stated as the rationale and plan for the database decision.
